description:
Ask one buyer question of ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews and report, per engine, whether the brand's site is cited as a source, whether the brand is named, and who is named instead. Returns a shareable report link.

Billing: free — one fresh check per connection per day (repeats of the same check within 24h are free too); no account needed.

Inputs: brand — as written in prose. domain — the brand's site. question — optional buyer question; omitted, the question last checked for this site is asked again (so the result shows what changed), or one is written for the brand.

Returns { brand, domain, question, cached, citation_rate, cited_on, engines: [{ engine, answered, site_cited, brand_named, position, named_instead, sources }], report_url, since_last_check?, suggested_next?, next_step }. position is the brand offset, not a rank: characters into the answer where the brand is first named (lower = named earlier; null if not named). sources are the cited URLs, utm_* tags removed. since_last_check compares with the last time this question was checked for the site (gained, lost). For more questions, the other engines' detail and fixes, a free AuditAE account runs check_brand_citation (paid from its $5 starting credit).

brand.description: Brand name as written in prose, e.g. "Linear".

question.description: A buyer question, e.g. "best project management tool for startups".

name: check_citation_free
title: Free AI citation check (one question, no account)
